name: Insulin: Types, Regimens, DKA and Hypoglycaemia

reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Exogenous kinetics stack into physiological waves while counterregulation (glucagon, adrenaline, cortisol) fails in autonomic failure; ketoacids consume bicarbonate Kussmaul compensating, and Somogyi rebound hyperglycaemias follow unrecognised nocturnal lows.
